subject: maths
title: Constructions
meta: Lesson practice set · Question types of the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: Practice set for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Every answer shows the working. Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: To divide a line segment AB in the ratio 2 : 3, a ray AX is drawn at an acute angle and marked at equal intervals. The minimum number of marks is —
questions.answer: D
questions.work: For a ratio m : n we need m + n equal parts: 2 + 3 = 5 marks.

questions.q: A triangle ABC with BC = 3 cm, ∠C = 30° and AB − AC = 3.2 cm —
questions.answer: B
questions.work:
By the triangle inequality AB < AC + BC, i.e. AB − AC < BC.
Here AB − AC = 3.2 cm is not less than BC = 3 cm, so no such triangle exists.

questions.q: To draw the perpendicular bisector of AB, the compass is opened to —
questions.answer: C
questions.work: Arcs from A and B meet only if each radius is more than half of AB.

questions.q: To construct a triangle similar to △ABC with sides 3/4 of it, the number of equal points to mark on the ray BX is at least —
questions.answer: B
questions.work: For a scale factor 3/4 we mark 4 points (the larger of 3 and 4), join the 4th to C, and draw the parallel through the 3rd.

questions.q: In the construction of tangents from P to a circle with centre O, the midpoint M of OP is used because —
options: the angle in a semicircle on OP is 90°
questions.answer: B
questions.work: The circle on OP as diameter meets the given circle at Q; ∠OQP is the angle in a semicircle = 90°, so PQ ⊥ OQ and PQ is a tangent.

questions.q: A triangle with AB + AC = 5 cm and BC = 6 cm —
questions.answer: B
questions.work: The sum of two sides must be greater than the third: AB + AC must exceed BC. 5 < 6, so it cannot be constructed.

sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark (fill in the blanks, match the columns or true/false).

questions.q: Write True or False: (i) △ABC with BC = 3 cm, ∠C = 30° and AB − AC = 3.2 cm can be constructed. (ii) For the perpendicular bisector of AB, the compass must be opened to less than ½AB.
questions.answer:
(i) False: we need AB − AC < BC, but 3.2 > 3.
(ii) False: the radius must be more than ½AB so that the arcs from A and B meet.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (i) To divide AB in the ratio 3 : 5, the ray AX is marked with ____ equal points. (ii) Tangents from an external point to a circle are ____ in length.
questions.answer:
(i) 3 + 5 = 8.
(ii) equal.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (i) To make a triangle similar to △ABC with sides 2/3 of it, B₃ is joined to C and the parallel is drawn through ____. (ii) To construct ∠45°, bisect an angle of ____.
questions.answer:
(i) B₂ — the 2nd mark (m = 2, n = 3).
(ii) 90°.

questions.q: Write the steps to divide a line segment of 7 cm internally in the ratio 3 : 4.
questions.answer:
1. Draw AB = 7 cm.
2. Draw a ray AX making an acute angle with AB.
3. With a fixed compass opening, mark 3 + 4 = 7 equal points A₁, …, A₇ on AX.
4. Join A₇B.
5. Through A₃ draw a line parallel to A₇B (copy ∠AA₇B at A₃) meeting AB at P.
6. Then AP : PB = 3 : 4 (AP = 3 cm, PB = 4 cm).

questions.q: Write the steps of construction of tangents to a circle of radius 3 cm from a point P 6 cm from its centre O.
questions.answer:
1. Draw a circle of radius 3 cm with centre O.
2. Mark P with OP = 6 cm and join OP.
3. Draw the perpendicular bisector of OP; let it cut OP at M (OM = 3 cm).
4. With centre M and radius MO draw a circle cutting the given circle at Q and R.
5. Join PQ and PR — these are the tangents.
6. Check: PQ = √(6² − 3²) = √27 ≈ 5.2 cm.

questions.q: Draw a line segment of 7 cm and find a point P on it dividing it in the ratio 3 : 5. Write the steps.
questions.answer:
1. Draw AB = 7 cm and a ray AX at an acute angle to it.
2. Mark 8 (= 3 + 5) equal points A₁ … A₈ on AX.
3. Join A₈B.
4. Through A₃ draw A₃P ∥ A₈B, meeting AB at P.
5. AP : PB = 3 : 5 (AP = 21/8 = 2.625 cm).

questions.q: Construct △PQR in which QR = 8 cm, ∠Q = 30° and PQ − PR = 2 cm. Write the steps.
questions.answer:
1. Draw QR = 8 cm.
2. At Q make ∠RQX = 30°.
3. Cut QS = 2 cm (= PQ − PR) on QX.
4. Join SR.
5. Draw the perpendicular bisector of SR; let it meet QX produced at P.
6. Join PR. △PQR is the required triangle.
Why: P is on the bisector of SR, so PS = PR, and PQ − PR = PQ − PS = QS = 2 cm.

questions.q: Construct △PQR in which PQ + PR = 8.2 cm, QR = 3.6 cm and ∠Q = 45°.
questions.answer:
1. Draw QR = 3.6 cm.
2. At Q make ∠RQX = 45°.
3. Cut QS = 8.2 cm on QX.
4. Join SR and draw its perpendicular bisector, meeting QS at P.
5. Join PR. △PQR is the required triangle.
Why: PS = PR, so PQ + PR = PQ + PS = QS = 8.2 cm.

questions.q: Construct △ABC in which BC = 4 cm, ∠B = 60° and AB − AC = 1.2 cm.
questions.answer:
1. Draw BC = 4 cm.
2. At B make ∠CBX = 60°.
3. Cut BD = 1.2 cm on BX.
4. Join DC and draw its perpendicular bisector, meeting BX produced at A.
5. Join AC. △ABC is the required triangle (AD = AC, so AB − AC = BD = 1.2 cm).

questions.q: Construct a triangle ABC with sides AB = 3 cm, BC = 4 cm and AC = 6 cm. Then construct a triangle similar to it whose sides are 2/3 of the corresponding sides of △ABC.
questions.answer:
1. Draw BC = 4 cm. With centre B radius 3 cm and centre C radius 6 cm draw arcs meeting at A. Join AB, AC.
2. Draw a ray BX making an acute angle with BC, on the side opposite to A.
3. Mark 3 equal points B₁, B₂, B₃ on BX.
4. Join B₃C.
5. Through B₂ draw a line parallel to B₃C meeting BC at C′.
6. Through C′ draw a line parallel to CA meeting BA at A′.
7. △A′BC′ is the required triangle: A′B = 2 cm, BC′ = 8/3 ≈ 2.67 cm, A′C′ = 4 cm.

or.q: Draw a circle of diameter 6 cm. From a point P 7 cm from its centre, draw two tangents to the circle.
or.answer:
1. Draw a circle with centre O and radius 3 cm.
2. Mark P with OP = 7 cm; join OP.
3. Bisect OP at M (OM = 3.5 cm).
4. With centre M and radius 3.5 cm draw a circle cutting the given circle at Q and R.
5. Join PQ and PR — the required tangents.
6. Each = √(7² − 3²) = √40 ≈ 6.3 cm.

questions.note: October 2024 used sides 5, 6 and 7 cm with the same scale factor 2/3.

questions.q: Construct a triangle ABC in which AB = 5 cm, BC = 4.2 cm and the median CD = 3.8 cm.
questions.answer:
D is the midpoint of AB, so BD = 2.5 cm.
1. Construct △BCD: draw BD = 2.5 cm; with centre B radius 4.2 cm and centre D radius 3.8 cm draw arcs meeting at C. Join BC and DC.
2. Produce BD to A so that DA = 2.5 cm (AB = 5 cm).
3. Join AC. △ABC is the required triangle, with median CD = 3.8 cm.

or.q: Draw a circle of radius 3.2 cm and from a point P outside it draw two tangents PQ and PR.
or.answer:
1. Draw a circle with centre O, radius 3.2 cm. Mark a point P outside it (say OP = 6 cm) and join OP.
2. Bisect OP at M.
3. With centre M and radius MO draw a circle cutting the given circle at Q and R.
4. Join PQ and PR; these are the tangents, and PQ = PR.

questions.q: Construct a triangle ABC in which AB + BC + CA = 10 cm, ∠B = 60° and ∠C = 30°.
questions.answer:
1. Draw XY = 10 cm (the perimeter).
2. At X make ∠YXL = 30° (= ½ × 60°); at Y make ∠XYM = 15° (= ½ × 30°). Let XL and YM meet at A.
3. Draw the perpendicular bisectors of AX and AY, cutting XY at B and C.
4. Join AB and AC. △ABC is the required triangle.
Why: B is on the bisector of AX, so BA = BX and ∠BAX = ∠BXA = 30°, giving ∠ABC = 60°; similarly ∠ACB = 30°; and AB + BC + CA = XB + BC + CY = 10 cm.

questions.q: Draw a right triangle ABC with BC = 12 cm, AB = 5 cm and ∠B = 90°. Construct a triangle similar to it with scale factor 2/3.
questions.answer:
1. Draw BC = 12 cm. At B construct ∠CBY = 90° and cut BA = 5 cm. Join AC (AC = 13 cm).
2. Draw a ray BX at an acute angle to BC, below it.
3. Mark 3 equal points B₁, B₂, B₃ on BX and join B₃C.
4. Through B₂ draw B₂C′ ∥ B₃C meeting BC at C′ (BC′ = 8 cm).
5. Through C′ draw C′A′ ∥ CA meeting BA at A′ (BA′ = 10/3 cm).
6. △A′BC′ is the required triangle.

questions.q: Construct a triangle ABC with AB = 6 cm, BC = 4 cm and median CD = 3.5 cm. Then construct a triangle whose sides are 3/4 of those of △ABC.
questions.answer:
1. BD = ½AB = 3 cm. Draw △BCD with BD = 3 cm, BC = 4 cm, CD = 3.5 cm; produce BD to A so that DA = 3 cm. Join AC.
2. Draw a ray BX at an acute angle to BC; mark 4 equal points B₁ … B₄.
3. Join B₄C; through B₃ draw B₃C′ ∥ B₄C meeting BC at C′.
4. Through C′ draw C′A′ ∥ CA meeting BA at A′.
5. △A′BC′ has sides 3/4 of △ABC (A′B = 4.5 cm, BC′ = 3 cm).
